Discounts are automatically applied to stays, no promo codes needed. The total price already includes your savings.

Each reservation of this property includes a credit to be used towards beach gear rentals and services at La Dolce Vita. This includes bikes, beach chairs, paddle boards, kayaks, tours/experiences and could even be used towards a beach bonfire for the entire family!



“Sunlit Sands”, is a beautifully appointed Gulfside getaway in the tranquil Water view community at Inlet Beach. 3 minute bike ride from the beach and just around the corner from 30A, this gorgeous home offers a King Suite , 2 guest rooms, 2 1/2 baths, an outdoor entertainment area, spacious first floor and ultra comfortable accommodations. Enjoy the modern amenities of a home brand new to the rental market. Perfect for family vacations or group retreats! Learn more below...



*** HIGHLIGHTS ***

Experience the best of 30A with these standout features that make “Sunlit Sands” the perfect choice for your coastal escape.

Perfect Coastal Location: Just a 3-Minute Bike ride to the Beach and Minutes to 30A. 5 minute walk to 30Ave.

Beach Amenities: Includes Beach Chairs and Umbrella for Ultimate Relaxation

Spacious Accommodations: 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, including a Primary bedroom with ensuite

Entertainment Ready: 65" HDTV with high-speed connectivity

Kitchen Amenities: Fully Stocked and including Stainless Steel appliances for Easy, Enjoyable Meal Prep

Outdoor Living: 2nd Floor Primary Balcony. Fully fenced in backyard with brand new grilling station and plenty of Seating. Screened in back patio.

Beach Bikes: Includes discounted beach bike partnership for exploring scenic 30A



*** LIVING AREAS ***

The open-concept living area, bathed in natural light, showcases modern coastal decor, creating a serene and inviting atmosphere. Perfect for unwinding after a beach day or entertaining loved ones, the space features a smart TV with streaming capabilities. Whether you seek quiet moments or lively gatherings, this space is designed to elevate your coastal retreat.



*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***

Whip up gourmet meals or casual bites in the fully equipped kitchen, featuring hi-end stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. The open layout includes a kitchen island with bar seating, making it easy to stay connected with your group while preparing meals.

Stainless Steel Appliances and Granite Countertops

Bar Seating for 3 with Dining Area for 8

Fully Stocked with Cookware, Indoor and Outdoor Dinnerware and Drink ware and Utensils



*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS AREAS ***

Florida’s fresh air greets you on the second-floor balcony with blue sky views. Equipped with adirondack seating, it’s the perfect setting for cozy evenings or morning coffee

Backyard fenced-in dining space, lounge seating and grilling station. Screened in back patio.



*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***

1st Floor: Easy access powder room

2nd Floor: King Guest Primary Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony access, en-suite with double vanity, soaking tub and walk-in shower.

Queen Suite: Comfortable Queen bed, flat-screen TV, ample closet storage

Twin Room - Two Twin beds, flat-screen TV and ample closet storage 



*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***

Located in the serene Water view at Inlet Beach community, “Sunlit Sands” offers 3 min walkable access to the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of the Gulf Coast. It’s also a short bike ride to the vibrant shops and dining of 30 Avenue and Rosemary Beach, plus 5 minute walking to Camp Helen State Park for nature lovers.

3-Minute Bike Ride to the Beach Access

30 Avenue Shopping and Dining – 5-Minute Walk

Rosemary Beach – 7-Minute Bike Ride



*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***

Promotion includes discounted bikes. Note: LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach

Please Note: 5 Beach Chairs are provided as a convenience



*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***

We’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy ongoing support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.



*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A EXPERIENCE ESCAPE!



Starter Amenity Package:



All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.







SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING: Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.



Amenities:

- 3 Minute Bike ride to beach!

- Short bike ride to Rosemary Beach, 30Ave, and 30A

- Screened in back patio area.

- Back Patio with dining table, seating area, grill and fire pit.

- 2nd Floor private balcony off of king suite

- King bed in the primary bedroom

- Queen Sleeper Sofa in family room

- Primary en suite bathroom with soaking tub, shower, and dual vanity

- 2.5 bathrooms

- Grill

- Wifi

- Free La Dolce Vita amenity credit



FAQ's

- Distance to the beach? About 0.4 miles

- Fenced-in backyard for privacy and relaxed entertainment for the kids.

- Coffee Maker Type? Regular Pot

- Grill on site? Yes (Propane grill)

- Community Pool? No

- Parking spots? MAX 2 vehicles in driveway depending on size of vehicles

- Amenities provided? Yes, amenity starter pack in unit: (paper towels/sponge/hand soap/dishwasher pod/dish soap/laundry pod/conditioning shampoo/body wash/trash bag.





*Credit program with La Dolce Vita does not apply equally to all rental units. The credit program is subject to limitations.*

**Please be aware that in this community and many others, there may be active construction going on. We are not held liable for this.**
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Panama City Beach is home to this vacation home. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Snorkeling, sailing, and surfing/body boarding offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
